//: The kit's client as @mistriwork/kit publishes it: each module built on its own, beside its declarations, so a
product outside this repository bundles the kit's page from the installed package with the kit's Vite preset
(@mistriwork/kit/vite) as this repository's products bundle it from source. scripts/build-packages.mjs emits it
with --noCheck into a stage and copies the client's share, with its stylesheets, faces and page, to
packages/kit/dist/client: config/tsconfig.client.json is what checks these modules, and checks them once.
Bundler resolution and ESNext modules, as Vite reads them; comments kept, since they say why.
